user_story:
As a user, I want to select a color from the select menu so that I can customize my preferences. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. When I select 'Red' from the color dropdown, I should be able to see it selected in the 'oldSelectMenu' element with id 'oldSelectMenu'.
2. If I do not select any color and try to submit, the URL should remain the same as 'https://demoqa.com/select-menu'.
